items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: Paul Moreas and George Abrunas, they played with the other band, Ben Pollack, you know, and all that stuff.

ctx.x: I heard of him. I never knew him. He was before I ever got here.

He was terrific. Good showman and all that stuff. But, like I say, I went to Chicago and I came back to New Orleans. I went back to the Palace. But I just wanted to go back to, you know, out of town, so I went back to Chicago. So, I went back there and I played the dance hall, like the Mary Garden. That was a big deal. And, who happened to have two dance halls ones? It was like a T. And, uh, Paul Moreas and George Abrunas, they played with the other band, Ben Pollack, you know, and all that stuff. That's where…
I know where the Drake Hotel is. That's about all I can remember now. It's been so many years ago. Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah.
